body:
Mad MDA
I measured out about 110mg of this stuff. I had previously taken 160 of mdma, and it didn't affect too hard (albeit it was from a vendor that was later questionably giving out methylone in its place). I decided to test the waters small and I could redose if I needed. I had a 40 mg redose pill ready. But holy fuck am I glad I took less.
I had a 40 mg redose pill ready. But holy fuck am I glad I took less.
(I had originally intended on taking 150mg!)
I started out by procrastinating and finally taking a shower. Over an hour had passed and I was wondering when this stuff was going to finally kick in. As I exited the shower, I was starting to feel different. I exited the bathroom, and it kicked in. Holy shit. My balance was off a bit, and I was getting dizzy. And it was getting worse. I dressed and put myself on the couch, sitting seemed to help with the dizziness, and watched 2 episodes of adventure time. I decided at this point that the drug would be much more appreciated laying down in my bedroom listening to electronic music. So, that's what I did.
I layed down in the dark and just enjoyed myself. I did masturbate, and it felt great, but when I came, it didn't feel as if I came, it felt more as if I just stopped getting intense pleasure, and I would have to work myself up again if I wanted to. I decided it wasn't worth the effort and to just enjoy the music. I felt relaxing, and enjoyable.
I did eventually go outside for a walk and get a slushie, but I was sobering up already. I enjoyed the walk. The trees did look cool though, I think, very green.
This isn't what I thought MDA would feel like. I was hoping to go outside, for an awesome bike ride.  I think I took too high of a dose. Next time I will take something like 60-80mg.
I also think the previous MDMA I took had to be methylone. Otherwise the dosages would have been at least similar. But I had fun, just not the kind of fun I thought it would be.
